title: Educational opportunities
headline:
Big discoveries.
Real connections.
introduction: Animals have a way of getting us to pay attention. Explore an educational visit that brings your group's questions about animals, nature, and care to life.
alt: An emu looks toward the camera in a green outdoor area.

sections.heading: Bring your questions
sections.body: Education is part of Critter Creek's mission. Observing animals and learning about their care can open conversations about kindness, responsibility, and the natural world.

sections.heading: For schools and curious groups
sections.body: Contact the ranch to discuss a school outing or group visit. Let us know the ages of your participants, group size, preferred dates, and any learning goals or access needs.

sections.heading: Everyday care, memorable lessons
sections.body: Why might a horse wear a fly mask? What goes into looking after an animal every day? The ranch's existing animal-care stories offer a starting point for observation and discussion.

sections.heading: Let's work out the details
sections.body: Program availability, activities, length, fees, and age suitability need to be confirmed with the team. Start an inquiry and we can talk about what is possible for your group.
